assume.ref: SketchLib_p4_16_fcm_p416_fcm: no controller in the SketchLib artifact; threshold assumed
assume.reason: SketchLib ships only README.md and compile.sh -- no controller, no entry dump, no threshold value -- so no cp-artifact can be cited. The sketch counter is compared against this control-plane action parameter OUTSIDE the RegisterAction (est = est - threshold, sink keyed on the sign bit), so without pinning it the argument stays free-symbolic and no packet count can be derived. Value 30 is deliberately low: k is replayed as real packets, so a realistic threshold would demand an impractical flood.
